description: Climber preferences and default grading scales stored on the user's repository

preferredRouteScale.description: User's preferred route grading scale. Should be unset to use the default notation for the place (crag or region).

preferredBoulderScale.description: User's preferred boulder grading scale. Should be unset to use the default notation for the place (crag or region).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when profile was created
